name: Igloo Corporation
tagline: AI-driven security monitoring (SIEM) solutions to counter cyber threats for Vietnamese businesses.
solution_summary: Igloo Corporation provides an AI-powered integrated security monitoring platform for real-time threat detection and response. target_buyer_display: Local telecom & ICT companies, public ICT institutions
